description: Non-standard properties the engine implements that no CSS specification defines. The HTML user-agent rules map colspan and rowspan to them.

table-column-span.source: HTML user-agent mapping: td[colspan], th[colspan] set table-column-span from the colspan attribute

table-row-span.source: HTML user-agent mapping: td[rowspan], th[rowspan] set table-row-span from the rowspan attribute
